name: Nyuu Type Sisters -Onedari Oppai-
original_name: 乳Typeしすたぁず　-おねだりおっぱい-
source:
Shinji lived the life of an ordinary college student until he woke up one morning and met a horny catgirl sleeping next to him. Shinji teaches Yuria all about human life and culture, at least how humans have sex. Meanwhile the mother ship sends down her sister Alissa to do invading of her own.

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=5986]ANN[/url]]
translation:
真嗣过着普通大学生的生活，直到有一天早上他醒来，遇见了睡在他旁边的一个性欲旺盛的猫女。真嗣向尤莉亚传授有关人类生活和文化的一切知识，至少是人类如何发生性行为。与此同时，母舰派出她的妹妹艾丽莎来进行自己的入侵。

[来自[url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=5986]ANN[/url]]
